desc: A graphical disk usage analyzer for the GNOME desktop
doc: baobab - A graphical disk usage analyzer for the GNOME desktop

baobab (a.k.a. Disk Usage Analyzer) is able to scan either specific folders (local and remote) or devices, in order to give the user a tree representation including each directory size or percentage in the branch. It also auto-detects any mounted/unmounted device. A graphical representation is also provided for any selected folder.

-a, --all-file-systems
Do not skip directories on different file systems. Ignored if DIRECTORY is not specified.
--help
Show command line options.
--version
Output version information and exit.
Bugs should be reported to the GNOME issue tracker at http://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/baobab/issues.
